ctx.x: I said, Amos, Mordecai, White. Step out. Hey, fellas, here's your bandmaster. Now, I'll be a line officer, and good luck to you. You play a wonderful trumpet. I was playing then a JW York and son trumpet, and he had an EA Couturier trumpet. And that made me have a love for the Couturier horn, and I bought the 10,000th instrument. No, 1,000th some odd. 1076. My boy's got, my grandson has the trumpet out there now. 1076, designed by EA Couturier and Sons. La Porte, Indiana. After he came to America to demonstrate…
Oh. You guys, Maurice Durand was in that.
